component.name: TokenBurnTrack
component.summary: Track token usage and cost of AI coding agents

description.p: TokenBurnTrack copies usage records from the local logs of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and any JSONL log you describe) into a database on your machine, prices each API call, and shows dashboards for cost, tokens, sessions, models and projects. History is kept after the agents delete or rotate their logs.
